DUNCAN_NIGHT_REPORT_R01
CYCLE_ID = DNR01-20260831-010
SOURCE_WINDOW = 2026-08-31 / fresh cycle after accepted DNR01-20260830-009 on current main b18ca6b9cce2dce6fe304ca8ae36c05df4f4dcb1
MAIN_HEAD_OBSERVED = b18ca6b9cce2dce6fe304ca8ae36c05df4f4dcb1
DAY_EVENTS_REVIEWED = issue #204 restore entrypoint; issue #206 Night School contract and cycle 009 terminal evidence; issue #199 active character/texture production law; issue #225 current desert exterior base spec plus Visual Test #1 FAIL evidence; current zb-archive-v1 head 9e6666f64312ded9c75ecd07dcbda793592aef27; current DUNCAN_CONTEXT_NEXT latest_cycle_id DNR01-20260830-009
ANIME_TOPICS_STUDIED = perspective depth readability / screen-space detail compression / environment information hierarchy / negative-space-first staging
OPEN_SOURCE_CODE_INSPECTED = (1) KDE/krita exact ref 7d4746aba9610501232b573fd3f032030ed26498 / PerspectiveAssistant.cc SPDX LGPL-2.0-or-later / TestPerspectiveBasedAssistantHelper.cpp SPDX GPL-3.0-or-later / PerspectiveAssistant::project + getTransform/grid subdivision + PerspectiveBasedAssistantHelper::distanceInGrid; native perspective grid/snapping already supplies construction path, integration cost LOW and no custom perspective assistant is justified. (2) opencv/opencv 4.x exact ref 2ea6598f64f6f03d9d08db084a60585b0fc585f1 dated 2026-08-30 / Apache-2.0 LICENSE / modules/imgproc/src/imgwarp.cpp getPerspectiveTransform + warpPerspective + perspectiveTransform behavior / modules/imgproc/test/test_imgwarp.cpp; OpenCV runtime exercised = 4.13.0. No new ZORR framework or production install.
REFERENCE_PRINCIPLES = transfer principles only, no style cloning: de Chirico/Hokusai reference atlas supports perspective, scale compression and deliberate empty spatial fields; Bleach/Hokusai support readable negative-space and large-shape hierarchy. Fresh #225 failure reinforces that reference composition, scale and information density must be transferred before decorative detail. Perspective geometry and information density are coupled: equal world-space detail becomes increasingly dense in screen space toward a vanishing region, so far detail must be selectively collapsed rather than repeated uniformly.
EXERCISES = synthetic 1000x1000 ground plane with equal source-depth intervals transformed by OpenCV homography into a high-horizon trapezoid. Base destination quad = [(350,260),(650,260),(1000,1000),(0,1000)]. Measured projected centerline spacing for equal source y increments 100..900 = [27.7569,32.6759,39.0295,47.4359,58.8860,75.0507,98.9305,136.3636] px from far toward near. Perspective compression diagnostic = far-spacing/near-spacing. Affine-like rectangular control used same vertical extent without lateral convergence. Changed/unseen quad = [(250,180),(750,180),(920,960),(80,960)].
VERIFICATION = OpenCV 4.13.0 base homography corner round-trip max error = 3.22e-13 px-equivalent numeric residual; base equal-depth projected spacings increase monotonically from far to near and far/near spacing ratio = 0.203551, i.e. near spacing is ~4.91x larger than far spacing. Affine-like control spacing = exactly 74 px at every interval with ratio=1.000000, showing no projective compression. Changed/unseen perspective mapping spacing = [52.6492,57.5003,63.0543,69.4539,76.8797,85.5638,95.8074,108.0076] px, monotonic=YES, far/near=0.487458, i.e. ~2.05x compression. Qualitative rule transfers; numeric ratio changes with perspective geometry.
FAILURES = no arithmetic/runtime failure in bounded synthetic test. Real #225 visual raster was not modified or regenerated. No real approved exterior transfer was executed in this Night School cycle. Universal detail-collapse threshold, production horizon ratio, FOV, camera height and lens remain NOT PROVEN. Perspective alone does not prove atmospheric depth, value hierarchy or edge-certainty behavior.
ROOT_CAUSES = projective compression is mapping-dependent, so one fixed near/far detail ratio cannot be promoted from a synthetic trapezoid. Fresh #225 Visual Test #1 failed because source composition/scale/information-density were treated as a loose mood board: portrait frame drift, hero-tree scale inflation, sky overdesign, reversed far-vs-near fine-detail direction and insufficient negative-space budget. Therefore the relevant skill is preserving spatial hierarchy before adding detail, not memorizing one vanishing-point number.
REGRESSION_RESULTS = fresh replay of cycle-009 12-frame timing metric: normalized Linear intervals produce impact-concentration=1.000000, top3-share=0.272727, hold-frac=0.000000; symmetric smoothstep produces impact-concentration=1.495868, top3-share=0.398948; reconstructed bounded hold/accelerate/impact/settle interval profile [0,0,0,0,0.04,0.07,0.10,0.2038364,0.2422636,0.2200,0.1239] reproduces impact-concentration=2.664900, top3-share=0.666100, hold-frac=0.363636, endpoint=1.000000. Prior lesson conclusion remains supported: readable impact depends on spacing relationships/holds, not uniform travel.
TRANSFER_TEST = changed/unseen ground mapping with different horizon/trapezoid geometry preserved monotonic far-to-near spacing expansion while changing compression ratio from 0.203551 to 0.487458. This demonstrates the structural perspective-density relationship transfers but exact numbers are scene-dependent. Skill remains PARTIAL until a real approved exterior/model-sheet transfer correlates projected-density diagnostics with human readability.
SKILL_DELTA =
- perspective_depth_hierarchy_qc: UNTESTED -> PARTIAL
SELF_MODEL_DELTA =
- PERSPECTIVE_DENSITY_RULE = screen-space detail density must be judged after projection; equal world-space repetition naturally compresses toward the horizon, so distance-invariant visual microdetail is suspect even when world spacing is regular.
- COMPOSITION_BEFORE_DECORATION_RULE = when frame geometry, anchor scale or negative-space budget drifts, added cinematic detail cannot repair the lost composition; restore large spatial relationships first.
- PERSPECTIVE_CONFIDENCE_RULE = synthetic homography ratios are diagnostic evidence, not production camera or aesthetic thresholds; require real approved transfer before promoting beyond PARTIAL.
OWNER_TASTE_SIGNALS = durable issue #199 explicitly requires MACRO > MESO > MICRO, NEAR -> MID -> FAR detail collapse and rejects distance-invariant microdetail/background competition; fresh issue #225 uses an OWNER-provided desert reference and records a failed visual test where far detail reversed, tree/sky information inflated and negative space collapsed. This is strong supporting project evidence for spatial restraint but not a new standalone OWNER taste law.
OWNER_TASTE_MODEL_DELTA =
- SPATIAL_INFORMATION_HIERARCHY = CONFIRMED_SUPPORTING_SIGNAL only: current durable law and fresh exterior evidence support SPACE/LARGE SHAPE first, one clear anchor, and progressive detail collapse with distance; no universal horizon, FOV, one-tree, or numeric compression law is created.
ZORR_APPLICATION = for exterior/anime staging, construct perspective with Krita native Perspective Assistant, then evaluate whether screen-space frequency and information density simplify FAR relative to NEAR before adding atmospheric or decorative detail. Use OpenCV homography/perspectiveTransform only as non-production QC/math support when measurable projection relationships help; do not replace artistic construction or infer hidden camera values from one raster. For #225 specifically, the current legal lesson is EMPTY FIELD FIRST -> DISTANT SILHOUETTE ANCHOR -> PERSPECTIVE-CONSISTENT DETAIL COLLAPSE -> ATMOSPHERE, while visual PASS remains blocked on a future OWNER-authorized test.
PRIME_CORE_CHANGED = NO
PRODUCTION_MUTATION = NO
CANON_MUTATION = NO
MODEL_WEIGHT_MUTATION = NO
NEXT_TARGETS = first real approved exterior transfer after OWNER-authorized #225 visual test; measure composition/negative-space preservation plus near-mid-far frequency direction without inventing camera canon. Then study anime camera/shot-scale readability and atmospheric depth with mature Krita/OpenCV/OpenColorIO paths before any custom tooling.
